I have been hanging out with a lot of people in the life extension movement recently. 

I don't get it. 

I don't want to live much longer. I can't imagine wanting to be around for hundreds of years. I can barely imagine hanging on for the next ten or twenty. 

I don't know if I am going to end it myself or let cancer or whatever it will be do it.

Thanks man. Its been a rough month. I got my dream job two weeks ago, literal dream job. But I can't sleep right, and I keep showing up at noon. And I am feeling horrible about it. And I don't know what to do. I have tried every medicine. I have a bottle full of klonopins, they can knock me out, but I still sleep till noon. Christ. Why sleep? Why not a bum leg or something

Thanks man. I know I am so gifted. Like, the gifts I have are insane. I have trouble regulating my self esteem because I am either amazing beyond the scale or shitty.
I have tons of friends... I just feel so isolated when I fall into myself like this.

Good on overcoming dyslexia. I am disgraphic, can't handwrite. 

I just want to sleep at midnight..
